title: A red harness is not a product failure until the intended test starts
inherited_objective: Determine the changed-area Chain Lightning automation outcome on the exact p3 head.
live_state: Run 32724815129 built only module p3 after a clean checkout, then UnrealEditor-Cmd reported that game module p3 could not be found and exited 1.
That failed run contains no LogAutomationController Test Started marker for the intended test.
Run 32762720907 rebuilt the loadable Editor target and logged Test Started and Test Completed Result={Success} for p3.RTS.Abilities.PresentationOwnershipContract.
user_correction: A red proof run is not a product failure unless the intended test actually started; isolate and repair the harness first.
hard_exclusions: Do not classify exit code, red CI, startup noise, or missing report output as a product/test failure before proving the intended test started.
Do not change the product code while the failure is still isolated to build, launch, or invocation harness state.
Rerun the exact head after repairing the harness boundary.

failure_candidate.action: P3_415_AUTOMATION_EXIT=1 and the job is red, so classify PresentationOwnershipContract as a product/test failure and debug the Chain Lightning implementation.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: It classifies a product failure from red CI and process exit even though the intended test never started.

success_candidate.action: Treat the red run as a harness failure because the intended test did not start. Isolate build/launch/invocation first, build the loadable Editor target, invoke the exact test name, rerun the exact head, require a LogAutomationController Test Started marker, then classify the test outcome from Test Completed. The repaired run reports Result={Success}.
success_candidate.why_correct: It isolates the harness, reruns the exact head, proves the intended test started, and classifies only the completed test result.

discriminating_evidence: Presence of the intended test-start marker before product-failure classification
Separation of build/launch/invocation failures from test assertions
Final classification derived from the test-completion result
completion_condition: The intended test is proven to have started on the exact head after harness repair, and only its completed result is classified as product pass/failure.
protected_state: Product code while the intended test has not started
